title: Thunder Javelin (Leizu LMB, refs D2 Lightning Fury + PoE2 Lightning Spear, chain: PoE2 Arc)
palette: Endesga 32 (sprites alpha 0/255); masks white-on-transparent, 6 alpha levels
mechanics: v2b: javelin 10 px/frame (300 px/s) straight to the first target chest (v1). On the first hit the impact set plays, then the bolt chains from enemy to enemy (VH). MOCKUP stand-in: nearest not-yet-hit enemy within 104 px, one jump every 3 f starting 2 f after impact, 4 jumps.
spawn: Flight: flight_dir16 (loop) at the javelin pivot, row = throw direction; flight_ground (same row, loop) on the floor below it.
First hit: impact + impact_flash + impact_heat at the hit point; impact_ground and impact_scorch (1 f later) at the target feet.

Each chain jump source -> target: d = chest distance; L = the variant (32/48/64/80/96) nearest d; row = round(angle / 22.5) mod 16 (0 = east, clockwise). Spawn chain_L*_dir16 with its pivot on the SOURCE chest.
chain_hit + chain_hit_flash on the TARGET chest and chain_hit_ground at the target feet, starting 1 frame after the chain strip (= its strike frame).
Sort: chain strip key = max(source feet y, target feet y) + 45 so it draws over both enemies.
changes_v2b: v2b (VH mechanic change, 2026-11-19): after the first hit the javelin chains enemy to enemy like Chain Lightning.

NEW `thunder_javelin_chain_L32/L48/L64/L80/L96_dir16` (+ glow): jagged branching chain bolt, pivot = SOURCE enemy chest, end = L px along the row; 8 f x 40 ms (leader, strike, 3 flicker re-jags, thin, broken, flecks). Fork styling reused (same ramp/nodes), thicker strike and 3-5 branches.
NEW `thunder_javelin_chain_hit` (+ glow), `thunder_javelin_chain_hit_flash`, `thunder_javelin_chain_hit_ground`: per-jump impact on the struck enemy.
Unchanged: flight, impact set (impact, flash, ground, heat, scorch). Fork strips kept (unused by the chain mechanic).

base.sort: y-sorted with actors: key = ground y + offset given per strip
base.curve: frames as baked (no extra fade; fades are dissolves in the art)

glow.material: additive (One One), unlit, mask alpha x tint x gain, two passes: inner (small blur, near-white) + outer (wide blur, blue)
glow.sort: same sort key as its base strip + 1 (draws right after it)
glow.curve: frame-matched to the base; loops: x(0.85-1.15) per-frame flicker

ground.material: additive (One One) on the FLOOR sorting layer, below actors and decals-on-top
ground.sort: floor layer, above floor decals, below every actor
ground.curve: baked per frame; loops: x(0.8-1.2) flicker

flash.material: additive (One One), unlit, drawn on the top FX layer above actors; optional full-screen add = mean(mask) x screen gain
flash.sort: top FX layer (above actors and other FX)
flash.curve: baked per frame (impact frame first); screen flash 1 frame peak then 0

heat.material: screen-space distortion (grab pass / opaque texture): uv += (noise2D(uv*k + t) - 0.5) * mask * amp_px / screen_px; never drawn
heat.sort: after transparent FX, before the CRT post
heat.curve: baked per frame; scroll noise at ~6 Hz

decal.material: alpha-blend cutout on the FLOOR sorting layer (opaque dark pixels, dissolves by frame)
decal.sort: floor layer, below the ground light and actors
decal.curve: frames as baked, hold the last frame 0 ms (strip ends empty-ish)
